component.name: Fetch
component.summary: A native desktop frontend for yt-dlp

description.p: Inspect media links, choose formats, and manage downloads in a native Linux desktop app.

Music-first M4A downloads now prefer native AAC streams. Music and Video presets, quick add, multi-link paste, command-line URL handling, and drag-and-drop make queueing faster. Playlist audio can use numbered album folders, synced LRCLIB lyrics are optional, and completed downloads offer Show in folder. Copy Diagnostics helps with troubleshooting.

Core path and queue modules now work without PyGObject for headless testing. Queue lifecycle coverage, corrected install and pause guidance, hourly retries for failed yt-dlp update checks, and detection of YouTube video URLs that include playlist parameters improve reliability.

Music downloads now use Artist - Title filenames, embed square artwork by default, and omit media IDs by default. Settings open faster with sidebar navigation, and the queue can be cleared manually or on quit.
